description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5
